title: Industrial Ventilation System Assessment
desc:
I am looking for a qualified HVAC engineer to verify whether the existing ventilation in our industrial manufacturing area still meets current standards and our production needs. I will supply you with detailed field data: measured airflow rates at each supply and exhaust point, full room dimensions and volume, exhaust-fan performance curves, occupancy numbers per shift, and other relevant observations taken on site.

With this information I need you to:

• perform fresh-air and extraction calculations in line with recognised codes such as ASHRAE or local equivalents,
• highlight any shortfalls or over-capacity you find,
• provide clear recommendations—either confirmation that the system is adequate or specific upgrades (for example fan sizing, additional air changes, or filtration improvements) if it is not.

Please return a concise engineering report that shows your calculations, assumptions, and conclusions so we can decide on next steps with confidence.

title: 30-Second Tamil School Promo
desc:
I need a concise, 30-second advertisement in Tamil that positions our school as the go-to choice for Academic excellence, aimed squarely at parents of young children who are just starting to explore schooling options.  

Here is what I’m after:  
• A compelling micro-storyboard and script in colloquial yet respectful Tamil that instantly reassures parents about our results-driven teaching.  
• AI-generated visuals―footage, motion graphics or animated characters, whichever best reinforces the message within the strict half-minute slot.  
• Matching Tamil voice-over and background music that feels upbeat and credible, mixed so every word is clear even on mobile speakers.  
• Final delivery in 1080p (MP4) plus the editable project file, ready for social-media placement.  

The spot must open with a strong hook on our consistent top exam scores and finish with a call-to-action inviting parents to schedule a campus visit. If you can weave data highlights into the visuals without overwhelming the viewer, even better. Please confirm your AI toolset and turnaround time when you respond.

title: Local Orders & Installs Ads
desc:
I’m looking for someone who can take full ownership of my Google Ads and Facebook (Meta) campaigns so we translate ad spend into real-world orders and app installs within one specific city/region.  

The mission is clear: set up, run, and continuously optimise search, display, and social placements that drive our prospects straight to checkout or the app stores. I already have creative assets and landing pages; what I need is your strategic media buying, keyword and audience refinement, and daily performance tuning.  

Core expectations  
• Build and structure both Google Ads and Meta Ads accounts for a single local market, including conversion and install tracking.  
• Research high-intent keywords, local interests, and look-alike audiences that match our target users.  
• Craft compelling copy and visual variations, launch A/B tests, and prune under-performers fast.  
• Monitor KPIs such as CTR, CPC, cost-per-order, and cost-per-install, making bid and budget adjustments to keep us profitable.  
• Provide concise weekly reports that translate the data into next steps I can understand at a glance.  

Acceptance criteria  
1. Campaigns go live error-free with Google Tag Manager & Meta SDK firing conversions correctly.  
2. Minimum 5% install-to-click rate and cost-per-order targets agreed before launch are met by the end of week two.  
3. A documented optimisation log is delivered every seven days.  

If you have a proven local-market playbook for both platforms and can start

title: Portal Mixed Data Entry
desc:
I have a cloud-based portal that needs to be populated with a mix of text and numerical information. All of the source material is ready: the bulk sits in structured Excel spreadsheets, and a smaller portion is contained in a series of Word documents. Your task is to transfer every field faithfully into the portal, double-checking that numbers keep their exact formatting and that text is copied without hidden characters or line-break issues.

I will provide:  
• Login credentials and a brief walkthrough video of the portal’s input screens  
• The spreadsheets and Word files, already organized by section so you can work in logical batches  

What I expect back:  
• 100 % of the supplied records entered, with no dropped rows or columns  
• Spot-checked accuracy of at least 99 % (I’ll run a quick audit)  
• A short completion log noting any ambiguous entries or source issues you encounter  

If you’re comfortable toggling between Excel, Word, and a browser tab while keeping an eye on detail, this should be straightforward work you can begin right away. Let me know your timing and any clarifying questions, and I’ll send over the materials.

title: Pre Education Vetting Project, Haddington-United Kingdom
desc:
I need a reliable partner who can confirm the academic history of candidates located in or around Haddington, United Kingdom. Once I send you the individual details, you will contact the relevant institutions, collect official confirmation of their studies, and supply clear evidence (email replies, stamped letters, or secure portal screenshots) that the information is genuine.  

The level of study may range from high-school certificates to university degrees or professional qualifications; I will specify the exact mix as soon as you come on board. What matters is that every check is carried out in line with UK data-protection rules, and that you return a concise verification report for each person that states:  
• the institution contacted  
• dates attended and the credential earned  
• the method of verification you used  
• any discrepancies discovered  

Turnaround time and accuracy are critical, so let me know your typical timelines and previous experience with education vetting when you bid.

title: Handwritten Document Transcription to Word
desc:
I have several pages of handwritten notes that need to be typed up accurately as editable text in Microsoft Word. The task is straightforward data entry—no numerical tables or mixed content—just clear, faithful transcription of the words exactly as written, preserving basic layout such as headings, paragraphs, and bullet points where they appear in the originals.

You’ll receive high-resolution scans of the manuscripts. I expect you to:

• carefully read each page,  
• transcribe every word without spelling mistakes, and  
• return a single, neatly formatted .docx file.

Please keep any personal or project information you see strictly confidential. Let me know your estimated turnaround time for roughly ten pages, and feel free to highlight previous experience with handwritten-to-Word transcription so I can award the job quickly.

title: Female or male On-Site Video Assistant
desc:
During an upcoming factory shoot in Ludhiana I need every card, SSD and audio recorder copied for 12 day shoot out (transportation offered if you are in delhi, chandigarh or punjab or nearby, hotel stay during) with a clear folder structure that mirrors the shot list.

You will:  
• Copy data from cameras, drones and recorders to two separate drives, verify with ensure nothing is deleted 
• Cut and edit straightforward sequences—no colour or heavy effects—just basic ins-and-outs, labelled and ready for review.  
• Sit beside the DP and producer, flagging any missed angles and noting retakes so the team keeps moving efficiently.  

The footage is entirely factory-floor content: machines, operator interviews and process walkthroughs. A beginner with familiarity in Premiere Pro is perfect; the priority is speed, organisation and the ability to stay calm amid the hustle.  

Deliverables at wrap:  
1. Just on site coordination 
2. A project file with all clips organised and rough-cut in chronological order.  
3. A short handover note detailing anything irregular (dropped frames, corrupted files, etc.).  

no need to bring any equipment

title: Multi-Element AI Video Production
desc:
I’m putting together a series of short, AI-generated videos and need a specialist who can handle the entire workflow—from concept through final render—while making sure each clip includes three non-negotiable elements: clear text overlays, a polished voice-over track, and royalty-free background music that fits the mood.

You’re welcome to work in the AI platform you know best—Synthesia, Pictory, Lumen5, Descript, Runway, or a custom Stable Diffusion / GPT-powered pipeline—as long as the end result is smooth and professional. I’ll supply an outline or rough script for each video; if you prefer, you can refine the copy yourself so the narration flows naturally with the on-screen text.

Here’s how I see the process:

• Pre-production: confirm the visual style, voice profile, and music vibe for each piece.  
• Draft cut: share a low-res watermarked preview so I can check pacing, overlay accuracy, and sound balance.  
• Final delivery: high-quality MP4 plus any project files I’d need for future edits.

Turnaround is important, but creativity is even more critical. If you’ve produced AI-driven explainer, promo, or training content before, point me to a sample—seeing your past work will help me gauge fit quickly.

Looking forward to collaborating on videos that look and sound like they were made by a full studio, not just a prompt.

title: Math Tutoring AI Product Expert Review
desc:
We're an AI-native team building an AI-powered 1-on-1 math tutoring product for K-12 students. Every lesson we build goes through expert review before it ever reaches a student, and we're looking for experienced math educators to do that review.

This is not a tutoring job. You won't be teaching real students. Instead, you'll play two roles in one session:

1. **Play a 5th grader** — engage naturally with our AI math tutor the way a real one would (asking questions, making common mistakes, sometimes staying quiet or confused)
2. **Evaluate the lesson as a professional educator** — assess whether the AI tutor taught the lesson effectively, following a structured rubric

Your feedback will directly shape how our AI teaches real students. This is a rare chance to shape how AI teaches math from the ground up.

**What You'll Do**

- Complete a simulated lesson session (5th grade math) by roleplaying as a student while interacting with our AI tutor
- At the same time, evaluate the lesson quality as a professional educator — this is the core of the role. Specifically, assess:
  - **Content accuracy**: Are the math explanations, problem-solving steps, and difficulty level correct and grade-appropriate?
  - **Teaching strategy**: Does the AI tutor guide the student well — asking follow-up questions instead of giving away answers, breaking down concepts at the right pace, adapting when the student struggles?
  - **Overall lesson experience**: Does the lesson feel engaging and age-appro

title: Indian Voice Integration for AI Calls
desc:
I am building an AI-driven calling solution on top of the OpenAI stack and need authentic Indian voices—both male and female—seamlessly integrated into the pipeline. The system will handle real-time customer service conversations, so clarity, natural intonation, and low-latency streaming are non-negotiable.

Here is what I need from you:
• Source or generate high-quality male and female Indian TTS voices that meet OpenAI compatibility requirements (Whisper, GPT-4, or any Speech-to-Speech layer you prefer).  
• Wire those voices into my existing call flow (currently running through Twilio Voice) so that the AI can listen, reason, and respond in real time.  
• Optimise for conversational turns under one second, with graceful fall-backs if network jitter occurs.  
• Provide a simple demo number where I can call in, interact with the bot, and hear both voices switch contextually.  
• Hand over clean, well-documented code and deployment steps so my dev team can maintain the integration.

Please submit a detailed project proposal outlining:
– Your chosen TTS engine(s) or custom model pipeline.  
– How you will preserve regional accents without sounding robotic.  
– Expected latency benchmarks and how you will achieve them.  
– A timeline with milestones all the way to live pilot.  
– Any previous voice or telephony integrations that prove you can deliver.

I am ready to move quickly once I see a solid, technically sound plan that demonstrates you understand customer service nuances

title: Desain Poster Profesional dan Berkualitas
desc:
Saya membutuhkan sebuah poster yang tampil menarik, rapi, dan sepenuhnya sesuai dengan arahan yang saya berikan. Kontennya sudah siap; Anda akan bertugas mengubahnya menjadi desain visual yang efektif—mulai dari tata letak, pemilihan warna, tipografi, hingga penyesuaian ukuran akhir untuk cetak maupun versi digital.  

Ruang lingkup pekerjaan:  
• Merancang konsep poster berdasarkan brief singkat dan referensi gaya yang saya sediakan.  
• Menyusun elemen grafis, gambar, serta teks agar komunikasinya kuat dan mudah dibaca.  
• Mengirimkan pratinjau awal untuk saya tinjau, lalu menindaklanjuti revisi seperlunya sampai desain final disetujui.  
• Menyerahkan file akhir dalam format siap cetak (PDF/CMYK 300 dpi) dan master file terbuka (AI/PSD).  

Saya menghargai ketepatan waktu; mohon sertakan estimasi durasi pengerjaan. Komunikasi responsif dan perhatian pada detail sangat penting bagi saya. Bila ada pertanyaan seputar spesifikasi, silakan ajukan—saya terbuka berdiskusi demi hasil terbaik.

title: Engaging Europe Travel Guides Needed
desc: I want to build out a series of travel guides that capture the same conversational, down-to-earth voice you used in your previous blog post. The focus is firmly on travel guides—not personal travel stories or destination reviews—so every piece should be structured to help readers plan a trip with clear, practical information while still feeling like a friendly chat. All guides will spotlight Europe. You can decide whether that means a country overview, a city deep-dive, or a themed itinerary, as long as each guide remains useful, inspiring, and easy to follow. Seamless integration of must-see sights, local tips, transport advice, and budget considerations is important, but keep the tone lively and relatable throughout. Please include the following in every guide: • A short, engaging introduction that sets the scene • Clear sections (e.g., getting there, where to stay, what to do, hidden gems) • Insider recommendations backed by up-to-date facts and links where relevant • A concise wrap-up with actionable next steps for travelers If you’d like more context on the style I appreciate, click here to see my earlier post. When you reply, let me know your favorite European destination to confirm you’ve read the brief, plus the number of guides you can comfortably deliver and your projected timeline.

title: स्वास्थ्य ब्लॉग पोस्ट लेखन
desc:
मुझे स्वास्थ्य और फिटनेस थीम पर आकर्षक ब्लॉग पोस्ट लिखवानी है। विषयों में आहार, व्यायाम, लाइफ-स्टाइल टिप्स जैसी सामान्य श्रेणियाँ रहेंगी, पर अंतिम निर्णय लेखन की प्रासंगिकता व ताज़ा शोध पर आधारित होगा।  
मैं चाहता हूँ कि:  
• लेख 800–1,000 शब्दों के हों, सरल-सीधी हिंदी में लिखे जाएँ।  
• शुरुआती पैराग्राफ़ पाठक को तुरंत जोड़े, बीच-बीच में उप-शीर्षक व बुलेट लिस्ट शामिल हों।  
• मूल, प्लैगरिज़्म-मुक्त सामग्री हो और तथ्य विश्वसनीय स्रोतों से सत्यापित हों।  
• SEO को ध्यान में रखते हुए मुख्य-शब्द (keywords) स्वाभाविक ढंग से पिरोए जाएँ।  

ड्राफ्ट मुझे Google Docs या Word फ़ाइल में दें, ताकि मैं टिप्पणियाँ जोड़कर अंतिम स्वीकृति दे सकूँ। एक नमूना अनुच्छेद या पूर्व का काम साझा करें तो निर्णय तेजी से लूँगा।

title: Detailed 2D & 3D AutoCAD Drawings
desc:
I need my mechanical components captured in both 2D and 3D inside AutoCAD. The 2D sheets will serve as full-blown technical documentation, so every visible and hidden edge, tolerance, surface finish note, and material callout must be there. From hole tables to section views, I want the drawings ready for immediate release to our shop floor and for inclusion in our quality files.  

Once the 2D set is signed off, the matching 3D models should reflect exactly the same geometry and constraints so we can use them for assembly checks and future finite-element analysis. Native DWG is essential; STEP or IGES exports are a plus.

Deliverables  
• High-detail 2D AutoCAD DWG files with complete specifications  
• Fully parametric 3D models in AutoCAD (and STEP/IGES if possible)  

I will supply sketches and existing measurements right after kickoff, and I’m available for quick clarifications to keep the turnaround smooth.

title: eBay Returns & Refunds Specialist
desc:
I run a growing USA-based store that sells exclusively on eBay, and the volume of post-sale questions has outpaced my capacity to keep response times tight. I’m looking for someone who can step in and own the entire returns and refund cycle on that platform.

Here’s what the role looks like day-to-day: you’ll monitor the eBay inbox, open cases when a buyer requests a return, guide them through the label process, track the package back to our warehouse, and issue the refund through eBay once the item is received and inspected. Clear, friendly communication is critical—I need customers to feel heard and confident at every step. You’ll also flag any potential abuse, follow eBay’s seller-protection policies, and keep concise notes in our shared Google Sheet so I can see status at a glance.

Deliverables  
• Same-day acknowledgment of all return requests (within 12 business hours).  
• Accurate refunds processed within 24 hours of item receipt.  
• Weekly summary report noting number of returns, reasons, and any disputes escalated.

Acceptance criteria: zero overdue return cases and a minimum 4.9/5 buyer communication rating over a 30-day period.

If you already know the ins and outs of eBay Seller Hub and have handled returns without dinging seller metrics, you’ll ramp up quickly. Let me know your experience and availability, and we can get started.

title: Formulate Next-Gen Protein Bars
desc:
I’m building a healthy-snacking startup and need a freelance food technologist who can turn my vision of premium, next-generation protein bars into two commercial-ready recipes for the Indian market. We will focus on a sweet flavour family, specifically chocolate-coffee notes, and I’m aiming for a soft, indulgent bite that still delivers functional nutrition (20 g protein, low sugar, clean-label ingredients).

Your brief is straightforward yet demanding: develop two bench-top formulations that can scale to pilot production, write clear step-by-step mixing SOPs, and map a reliable ingredient-sourcing strategy using suppliers available or shippable within India. I’ll provide detailed benchmarks, texture references, and nutritional targets once we execute an NDA.

Deliverables I’ll sign off on  
• Two complete recipe sheets (grams and % for every ingredient) matching the flavour and texture specs  
• Mixing & process SOPs detailed enough for a contract manufacturer to follow  
• Ingredient and supplier list with alternate options and MOQ/lead-time notes  

Acceptance criteria include sensory match to the benchmark bar, compliance with FSSAI limits, protein declaration supported by lab calculation, and stability for at least 9 months months at ambient temperature.

I’ve set aside a fixed stipend per flavour, released by milestone: formulation approval, pilot validation, and final dossier hand-off. Consultants, NPD specialists, or research scholars from institutes such as NIFTEM,

title: Indonesia Based: Finance and Human Resources Assistant
desc:

The immediate priorities are twofold: first day to day book keeping, issuing invoices via WIX, Stripe and Odoo, reconciling payments via our company bank account to prepare timely financial reports that management can trust.

We need someone who can introduce processes that would push to team to do their best and also ensure they work their hours.

The final HR component is reviewing hours and preparing payroll.

We will also need you to keep an eye on client emails from time to time to ensure emails are acknowledged if the team is not online.

Deliverables  
• Complete, reconciled payroll run every pay period and entered into Odoo as well as a G sheets management report 
• Journal entries automatically posted to the general ledger and matched to bank statements  
• Monthly P&L, balance sheet and cash-flow reports exported from Odoo 
• Monthly forecasting for management so we have visibility of what to expect incoming the next month.

Acceptance Criteria  
• Financial statements m

title: Roof Panel Forming Section Design
desc:
I'm seeking a skilled designer for the roof panel forming section of a sheets metal roof machine. I have rough sketches and need detailed mechanical drawings.

Key Requirements:
- Design the roof panel forming section
- Refine my rough sketches
- Create detailed mechanical drawings

Ideal Skills and Experience:
- Proficiency in mechanical design
- Experience with metal forming machinery
- Ability to work from rough sketches
- Strong technical drawing skills

Please share relevant portfolios and experience.

title: Boost Petroleum Jelly Pharma Sales
desc:
I manufacture high-grade petroleum jelly (LLP, HLP and related grades) and need immediate support turning more pharmaceutical companies into active, repeat buyers. My current outreach consists mostly of email campaigns and the occasional cold call, but the response rate is well below what these products deserve.  

Here is what I’m after:  
• A sales-driven action plan built specifically for pharma procurement teams—covering messaging, pitch decks, compliant samples, and a follow-up cadence.  
• Hands-on execution of that plan: prospect research, targeted emailing, call scheduling, and relationship nurturing until a purchase order is secured.  
• Transparent weekly reporting so I can see pipeline growth and, most importantly, a measurable increase in sales volume.  

If you already have contacts inside pharmaceutical labs or experience closing B2B lubricant or excipient deals, tell me. Let’s move fast—I can supply technical sheets, COAs, and pricing immediately so you can start converting prospects within the first week.

title: Handwrite Short Printed Text
desc:
I have a small batch of printed pages—no more than ten—that I need copied out neatly by hand. The task is straightforward: reproduce the text exactly as shown, preserving line breaks and basic formatting, but using your own clear, consistent handwriting. Perfect spelling and spacing are essential because I will be overlaying these handwritten versions onto a design project.

Here’s how I’d like to proceed: once you receive the PDF scans of the printed material, copy each page onto clean, unlined A4 sheets (black or blue ink only). When everything is finished, send back high-resolution scans or well-lit photos in either JPEG or PDF so I can review and approve. If any page needs minor adjustments for legibility or alignment, I’ll point that out, and you can revise just that section—no need to start over.

The assignment should be comfortable for students or homemakers looking for flexible, low-stress work; turnaround within two to three days of receiving the files would be ideal.

title: Commercial Building CAD Plan Updates
desc:
The schematic set for my mid-rise commercial building is already drafted, but only in PDF. I now need the drawings brought into CAD, cleaned up, and revised. 

Here is what must change:
• Layout modification—several internal walls shift to improve circulation.  
• Adding new rooms/features—the lobby will gain a coffee kiosk and two small meeting pods.  
• Updating existing details/measurements—column grids, door schedules, and ceiling heights need to match the latest site survey.  

Please trace or import the PDFs into AutoCAD (or compatible software), carry out the edits above with proper layers and line-weights, then return both the native DWG files and a publish-ready PDF set. All dimensions must close accurately, and the title blocks should keep my current project information intact.

I’ll supply the full PDF package and survey notes as soon as we start; you simply send back the updated drawings and a short change log so I can review and sign off.

title: Hindi Handwritten Book Typing & Formatting
desc:
I have a complete Hindi manuscript written by hand that now needs to be typed and laid out professionally. Every page must be reproduced accurately in Unicode Hindi, then arranged so the finished file mirrors the structure of the original book—chapters, sub-headings, quotations, boxed notes, and any other special sections or layouts I indicate along the way.

If you have recent experience auditing modern web stacks and can begin soon, I’d like to hear about your methodology and timeline.
